info.title: Domestic Payments Service API
info.description:
Internal API specification for SVC-009 (Domestic Payments). This service is primarily event-driven — it consumes PaymentCleared (EVT-P04) to execute Faster Payments and publishes PaymentExecuted (EVT-P05) on acceptance. The only synchronous API exposed is POST /cop/verify — the Confirmation of Payee proxy used by the channel during payment entry.

SVC-009 is a NEW service introduced by JRN-002. It holds the FPS scheme connectivity (via Form3 or equivalent managed infrastructure). It does not expose any public or customer-facing endpoints — all consumption is internal via the channel (SVC-017 → POST /cop/verify) or event-driven.

servers.description: Internal API gateway — production. Not accessible from external networks.

x-event-driven-responsibilities.description: SVC-009's primary responsibilities are event-driven. These are documented here for completeness alongside the synchronous API.

consumed_events.action: Constructs ISO 20022 pacs.008 (FIToFICustomerCreditTransfer) message and submits to Pay.UK/Vocalink FPS infrastructure. Creates PaymentExecution entity (ENT-009). Implements retry policy: up to 2 retries with 3s/6s exponential backoff on timeout.

published_events.trigger: FPS acceptance acknowledgement received from Vocalink (pacs.002 status = ACCP)
published_events.payload_summary: payment_execution_id, payment_intent_id, fps_reference, fps_message_id, settlement_status=accepted, amount, currency, payee_sort_code, payee_account_number, execution_timestamp

published_events.trigger: FPS rejection received (pacs.002 status = RJCT) or submission timeout after retry exhaustion
published_events.payload_summary: payment_intent_id, failure_reason (fps_rejection | fps_timeout), fps_reject_reason_code (when rejection), failed_at

post.description:
Synchronous proxy to the Pay.UK Confirmation of Payee (CoP) service. Called by the channel (SVC-017) during payment entry before SCA and PaymentIntent creation. Returns the CoP result for display to the customer.

**PSR SD17 obligations:**
- 100% of outbound FPS payments must have a CoP check (GOV-003-R02)
- Result must be presented to customer before authorisation
- No-match and partial-match must display a standardised fraud risk warning

**Performance:** Must return within 2,000ms P99 (scheme SLA). SVC-009 times out the Pay.UK CoP call at 1,500ms and returns cop_result = not_available on timeout.

200.description: CoP check completed. Result must be presented to the customer.

400.description: Invalid sort code or account number format

503.description: CoP service unavailable. The channel must present cop_result = not_available to the customer. Payment may proceed per PSR SD17 rules for not_available results.

example.message: Confirmation of Payee service is temporarily unavailable

get.description: Returns the PaymentExecution record (ENT-009) for a given payment execution. Internal use only — for Payment Operations monitoring, reconciliation, and investigation. Not called by the channel; channel uses SVC-001 GET /payments/{id} for status.

ServiceAuth.description: Service-to-service JWT issued by the bank's internal IAM. For POST /cop/verify: the calling service must be SVC-017 (Digital Channels). For GET /executions: Payment Operations internal tooling.

payee_sort_code.description: 6-digit sort code of the payee account (no hyphens).

payee_name.description: Name of the payee as entered by the customer. This is the name matched against the receiving bank's record.

account_type.description: Type of payee account. Required by Pay.UK CoP scheme for correct matching logic.

cop_result.description:
CoP check result.
- match: payee name matches the name registered with the receiving bank
- partial_match: payee name is similar but not exact (e.g. abbreviated name, nickname)
- no_match: payee name does not match the name at the receiving bank
- not_available: receiving bank not CoP-enabled, or service temporarily unavailable
- account_does_not_exist: sort code + account number combination is not a valid account

matched_name.description: The name registered at the receiving bank. Only returned for partial_match results to allow the customer to identify the discrepancy. Not returned for no_match (to limit data disclosure). Required for partial_match only.

risk_warning_required.description: True when cop_result is partial_match or no_match. The channel MUST display the PSR SD17-compliant risk warning and require explicit customer confirmation before proceeding.

cop_reference.description: Reference returned by the Pay.UK CoP service. Stored by the channel for the CoP audit trail.

fps_reject_reason_code.description: ISO 20022 pacs.002 reason code. Present when settlement_status = rejected.

cop_result_to_present.description: For 503 responses — the cop_result value the channel should treat this as.
